profile.headline: Software Engineer at Notion
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with many years of rich experience, establishing good engineering fundamentals from Google and Facebook, building scalable services and culture as an early engineer at Robinhood, a hyper-growth company, and driving large business impact by engaging in cross-functional efforts at Airbnb.

I have also supplemented my working experience with a Master of Science degree in Computer Science at Stanford University, concentrating in AI and Machine Learning. 

I have a passion for data and making data-driven decisions. While working, I put a huge emphasis on collaboration and mentorship, helping others grow their own skills.

positions.description: Experimentation and Data Platform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Data Governance, Security, and Privacy.
Leading AI-driven data classification initiatives

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Experimentation & Metrics Platform (Tech Lead)
- Revamped analysis platform to deliver analysis scorecard results in near-real time
- Architected self-serve metrics repository to simplify metrics onboarding and centralize datasets
- Scaled experiment data pipelines to handle hundreds of running experiments by
migrating from Presto to Spark
- Scaled assignment service to support 5x peak load

Clearing Platform
- One of the early engineers to help launch Robinhood's in-house clearing service
- Built out microservices responsible for central parts of clearing including accounting, corporate actions, tax reporting, securities lending
- Architected Robinhood's margin securities lending system, a core revenue driver
positions.insights: Skills: Kafka · Python (Programming Language) · Apache Spark · Presto · Hive

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for leading recitation sections, grading and writing homework, and holding office hours for CS courses on algorithms, natural language processing, probability, and discrete mathematics.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Built data pipelines and trained classifiers to predict how likely admins of Facebook groups would accept or reject auto-reported spam posts
• Reduced number of false positives by 120K posts per day
• Increased recall by escalating 30K reports to deletions and feedlimits per day

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Fully decomposed the current Aspera Files provisioning process and reimplemented it as an automated workflow in ServiceNow
• Cut down manual overhead from up to 6 hours to several minutes
Improved existing, developed and designed new microservices to provide APIs to support provisioning workflow
Enhanced Aspera customer usage portal, improving the user's experience of viewing their Aspera on Demand and Files product usage

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
•   Researched current methods for string graph assembly of genomes
•  Theorized a ‘not-so-greedy’ approach and helped proved its feasibility under sufficient conditions
•  Wrote a full implementation of the algorithm in C++ 
•  Produced graphs comparing n50 scores that show huge improvements over current methods
•  Contributing author to published paper

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Implemented a full pipeline that tracks and publishes metrics for the throttling system in the Ads Budgeting team
• Wrote scripts to extract and calculate metric prediction stats daily that were run on jobs managed by Google’s machine cluster management system
• Published metrics to a dashboard and experimented with updated weights associated with these predictions using machine learning tasks

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Designed and created an activatable UI metrics tool with a simple pluggable interface for Ads applications using AngularDart
• tool records and reports client-side page information
• tool records Angular specific information; i.e: cache sizes, slowest digests
• tool is used by two Google Ads applications that use AngularDart

positions.title: EE20 Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Lead discussion and lab sections for 30 students in our lower-division Signals and Systems course
• Wrote up lecture notes, discussion worksheets, and homework solutions for the class in Latex
• Managed and coordinated all of the readers who grade homeworks and provided feedback to improve the course throughout the semester

positions.title: EE20N Reader
positions.description: Spent time grading student's homework for the Intro to Signals and Systems class. In addition, I wrote practice problems using Latex to prepare students for their midterms.

positions.title: CS61A Reader
positions.description: Grading student's homeworks and projects for CS61A, the introductory cs course taught in Python

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: I assisted students in the lab for the introductory course taught in Python

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
• Hired as the first intern for their startup
• Implemented much of the APIs, both server-side and client-side,     
  for the company’s dashboard in AngularJS
• Implemented and design of users’ account settings and management
• Created necessary database constraints using postgreSQL and wrote the majority of their j-unit tests

honors.title: UC Berkeley Regents' and Chancellors' Scholar
honors.description: The Regents’ and Chancellor’s Scholarship is the most prestigious scholarship offered by UC Berkeley to entering undergraduates and attracts, retains, and graduates the most sought-after students in the world. The program is firmly supported by more than 200 Berkeley faculty and is unique in that it uses faculty to interview candidates.

projects.title: Nachos Operating System
projects.description: Worked in a team of 5 to create a functional Java-based operating system program. Implemented functionality including  synchronization primitives, multi-threading, scheduling, multiprogramming, file system interaction, system calls, and a distributed, transactional key-value store.
